name: Sikagard-680 S Betoncolor

SIKAGARD®-680 S BETONCOLOR: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor, March 2025, Version 04.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/sikagard_-680_s_betoncolor.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 04.03).
1.2 Product description. Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor is a 1-part, solvent-based, decorative methacrylic protective coating for concrete and cementitious surfaces. It protects against aggressive atmospheric influences and promotes a self-cleaning effect on the treated surfaces. It is available in clear and coloured versions. Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor complies with the requirements of EN 1504-2 as a protective coating.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. As a protective and decorative coating for:
    - The protection and enhancement of concrete cementitious substrates on building and infrastructure elements
    - Reducing the deterioration of concrete and assisting with controlling the corrosion of any embedded steel reinforcement
    - Increasing the service life to all types of concrete structures and elements such as buildings, bridges, car parks
    - Exterior use only
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Suitable for.
    - Protection against ingress (Principle 1, method 1,3 of EN 1504-9),
    - Moisture control (Principle 2, method 2,3 of EN 1504-9)
    - Increasing the resistivity (Principle 8, method 8,3 of EN 1504-9)
1.5 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.14.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Protective coating for concrete
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - CE Marking and Declaration of Performance to EN 1504-2 - Surface protection product for concrete - Coating
    - Surface Protection System OS-B TL/TP OS, ZTV-SIB 90, Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor, Institut für Bauforschung, Test report No. A3026/B2
    - Surface Protection System OS-C TL/TP OS, ZTV-SIB, Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor, Institut für Bauforschung, Test report No. A 2216/C1
    - Surface Protection System TL/TP OS, ZTV-SIB 90, Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor, Polymer Institut, Test report No. P 3132-1
    - Surface Protection System DIN EN 1504-2, Sikagard®- 680 S Betoncolor / Sika MonoTop®-622, Sika Deutschland GmbH, Test report No. OS 4 622-680
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 1504-2: cited elsewhere in the data sheet; cited with a stated property or value; listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1); Description (p.1); Product Information > Product declaration (p.2).
    - EN 1504-9: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Uses > Suitable for: (p.1).
    - DIN EN 1504-2: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
    - EN ISO 7783: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Diffusion resistance to water vapour (p.2).
    - EN 1062-6: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Carbonation resistance (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Good resistance against weathering and ageing
    - Quick drying
    - Available in many colours
    - Good opacity (coloured version)
    - Applied by brush, roller or airless spray
    - Clear coating to maintain decorative exposed aggregate features
    - Rain resistant within a short time
    - Maintains the texture characteristics of the surface
    - High diffusion resistance against CO2 reducing the rate of carbonation
    - Water vapour permeable
    - Reduced tendency to dirt pick-up and contamination
    - Suitable for sealing of green concrete in civil engineering works
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Solvent-based acrylate resin
    - Product declaration: EN 1504-2: Surface protection product for concrete - Coating
2.6 Appearance and colour. Thixotropic liquid
    - Available in VicRoads grey, white and clear glaze.
    - When the product is exposed to prolonged direct sunlight, splashed water containing de-icing salts or sea water, there may be some discolouration, a change in surface finish and colour variation. This has no influence on the function and performance of the product finish.
    | Clear coating | Final appearance: |
    | Smooth gloss finish |
    | Coloured coating | Final appearance: |
    | Smooth matt finish |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.7 Density.
    | Clear coating | ~0,9 kg/l (+20 °C) |
    | Coloured coating | ~1,4 kg/l (+20 °C) |
2.8 Flash point.
    | Clear coating | ~+25 °C |
    | Coloured coating | ~+30 °C |
2.9 Solid content by volume.
    | Coloured coating | ~45 % |
2.10 Diffusion resistance to water vapour.
    | Dry film thickness | d = 140 µm |
    | Equivalent air layer | SD, H2O = 2,4 m |
    | thickness |
    | Diffusion coefficient | µH2O = 1,8 × 10⁴ |
    | Requirement for | SD, H2O ≤ 5 m |
    | breathability |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (EN ISO 7783)
2.11 Carbonation resistance.
    | Dry film thickness | d = 130 µm |
    | Equivalent air layer | SD, CO2 = 429 m |
    | thickness |
    | Diffusion coefficient CO2 | µCO2 = 3,3 × 10⁶ |
    | Requirement for | SD, CO2 ≥ 50 m |
    | carbonation resistance |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (EN 1062-6)
2.12 System structure. Clear coating
    | Product | Number of coats |
    | Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor | 2 |
    | Coloured coating |
    | Product | Number of coats |
    | Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor | 2 (with or without primer) |
    | Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor for | 3 |
    | bright yellow and red colour shades |
    | Sikagard®-702 W hydrophobic im- | 1–2 |
    | pregnation primer |
    | Sikagard®-700 S hydrophobic im- | 1–2 |
    | pregnation primer |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 3) for the layout.)
    Note:In marine environments or if the concrete surface is exposed to splashes of de-icing salts, use a hydrophobic impregnation primer for improved protection and durability.
2.13 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 36 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.
2.14 Packaging.
    | Clear coating | 20 kg container |
    | Coloured coating | 30 kg containers |

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 04.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment. Concrete without existing coating

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 04.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Curing treatment: Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor does not require any special curing but must be protected from rain for at least 1 hour at +20 °C
4.3 Consumption.
    | Product | Per Coat |
    | Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor Clear | ~0,15 kg/m² |
    | coating |
    | Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor Col- | ~0,20 kg/m² |
    | oured coating |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    These figures are theoretical and does not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level, wastage or any other variations. Apply product to a test area to calculate the exact consumption for the specific substrate conditions and proposed application equipment.
4.4 Layer thickness. Minimum dry film thickness (DFT) to achieve full durability characteristics (CO2 diffusion, adhesion after thermal cycling, etc.) = 101 μm. Maximum DFT to comply with H2O equivalent air thickness of 5 m = 290 μ m.
4.5 Waiting time to overcoating. Waiting time between coats:
    | Temperature | Time |
    | +10 °C | ~8 hours |
    | +20 °C | ~5 hours |
    | +30 °C | ~3 hours |
    Note:Refresher coats of Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor can be applied without priming if the existing coating is fully bonded and is thoroughly cleaned.
    Times are approximate and will be affected by film, thickness and changing ambient conditions particularly temperature and relative humidity.
4.6 Applied product ready for use. Full cure: ~5 days (+20 °C); Dust dry: ~30 minutes (+20 °C). Times are approximate and will be affected by film, thickness and changing ambient conditions particularly temperature and relative humidity.
4.7 Equipment - Preparation equipment.
    - Steam cleaning equipment
    - Abrasive blast cleaning equipment
    - High-pressure water jetting equipment
4.8 Equipment - Application equipment.
    - Brush
    - Short pile fleece roller
    - Airless spray pressure: 150 bar, nozzle diameter: 0,38 to 0,66 mm, angle: 50° to 80°
4.9 Important. For use as a protective coating, new concrete must be at least 28 days old. 1. Clean the substrate and make sure it is dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, surface treatments and loose friable material which could reduce the adhesion of the Product. 2. Prepare the substrate using steam cleaning, abrasive blast cleaning, high-pressure water jetting or similar methods to achieve a textured surface profile suitable for the Product thickness and required adhesion values. 3. Prefill surface defects, blowholes, cavities pores etc. using a pore filler (e.g. Sika MonoTop®-723 N, Sikagard®-720 EpoCem® etc.) to provide a defect free surface. 4. Allow Sika MonoTop®-723 N, to cure for at least 4 days or 24 hours if Sikagard®-720 EpoCem® is used. Concrete with existing coating
4.10 Important.
    - Test the existing coating to confirm adhesion to the substrate and compatibility. As guidance, in the absence of any national standards or regulations, adhesion test average ≥ 1,0 N/mm² with no single value below 0,7 N/mm².
    - Inadequate adhesion 1. Completely remove existing coatings using abrasive blast cleaning, high-pressure water jetting or similar methods. 2. Prefill surface defects, blowholes, cavities pores etc. using a pore filler (e.g. Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor, Sika MonoTop®-723 N, Sikagard®-720 EpoCem® etc.) to provide a defect free surface. 3. Prefill surface defects, blowholes, cavities pores etc. using a pore filler (e.g. Sika MonoTop®-723 N, Sikagard®-720 EpoCem® etc.) to provide a defect free surface. 4. Allow Sika MonoTop®-723 N, to cure for at least 4 days or 24 hours if Sikagard®-720 EpoCem® is used. Adequate adhesion
4.11 Important.
    - Existing water-based coatings must be removed IMPORTANT
    - Confirm existing coating compatibility, adequate surface preparation and Product adhesion, by carrying out preliminary trials with adhesion tests before full application. 1. Thoroughly clean the existing fully bonded coating surfaces using steam cleaning, low / high-pressure water jetting or similar methods to remove all contaminants.
4.12 Application.
    - Strictly follow installation procedures as defined in method statements, application manuals and working instructions which must always be adjusted to the actual site conditions.
    - Note:Confirm waiting / overcoating times of any previous coats is achieved before applying subsequent coats. (Refer to waiting / overcoating time in Application Information)
    - Note:Confirm product application conditions: substrate moisture content, substrate, air and product temperatures, relative humidity and dew point (Refer to Application information).
    - Primer coat (If required) 1. Apply the primer evenly over the surface at the required consumption. Refer to the appropriate Product Data Sheet. 2. Protect primer from rain before applying protective coating.
    - Protective coating
    - Note:The product is supplied ready for use. For the coloured version, before application, mix for 2 minutes using a low speed electric single paddle mixer or similar equipment. Mix the liquid and all the coloured pigment until a uniform colour has been achieved.
    - Note:For the coloured coating, on very absorbent and/or porous substrates, it is recommended to mix in ~50 % of Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor (Clear version) into the Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor (Coloured version) for the first coat.
    - Manual application 1. Apply the Product evenly over the surface with a brush or short pile fleece roller at the required consumption. 2. Control the layer thickness during application using a thickness gauge. 3. To achieve a smooth finish, smooth the surface with a brush. 4. The coating must be continuous, pore free and to the required surface finish. 5. Protect the Product from rain for at least 24 hours. 6. Apply additional coats as required.
    - Spray application 1. Spray apply the Product in a continuous operation and at a speed to achieve a consistent thickness and surface finish. 2. Control the layer thickness during application using a thickness gauge. 3. The coating must be continuous, pore free and to the required surface finish. 4. Protect the Product from rain for at least 24 hours. Apply additional coats as required.
    - Sealing green concrete 1. Apply the Product evenly over the surface with a brush, short pile fleece roller or air less spray at the required consumption. 2. The coating must be continuous and pore free. 3. Protect the Product from rain for at least 24 hours. 4. Apply additional coats as required.
4.13 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with Sika Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically.
4.14 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not apply if rain is expected.
    - For lightweight concrete façades, it is recommended to use a crack bridging intermediate coat such as Sikagard®-550 W Elastic.
    - On fair faced and precast concrete, bubbles may occur if the coating application is carried out during rising temperatures. To prevent this occurring, make sure substrate pores are filled with a pore filler of Sika® MonoTop®- 723 N or Sikagard® -720 EpoCem®.
    - Dark colour shades (especially black, dark red and blue, etc.) may fade quicker than other lighter colour shades. Therefore, a maintenance / refresher coat might be required at an earlier interval than usual.
    - For consistent colour matching, make sure the Product in each area is applied from the same control batch numbers.
4.15 Further documentation.
    - Sika Method Statement: Protective Coatings

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C min. / +35 °C max.
5.3 Relative air humidity. < 85 %
5.4 Dew point. Substrate and ambient temperature must be at least 3 °C above dew point.
5.5 Substrate temperature. +5 °C min. / +35 °C max.
5.6 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.14):
    - Do not apply if rain is expected.
    - On fair faced and precast concrete, bubbles may occur if the coating application is carried out during rising temperatures. To prevent this occurring, make sure substrate pores are filled with a pore filler of Sika® MonoTop®- 723 N or Sikagard® -720 EpoCem®.
5.7 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - These figures are theoretical and does not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level, wastage or any other variations. Apply product to a test area to calculate the exact consumption for the specific substrate conditions and proposed application equipment.
    - Test the existing coating to confirm adhesion to the substrate and compatibility. As guidance, in the absence of any national standards or regulations, adhesion test average ≥ 1,0 N/mm² with no single value below 0,7 N/mm².
5.8 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Diffusion resistance to water vapour: Dry film thickness | d = 140 µm; Equivalent air layer | SD, H2O = 2,4 m; thickness; Diffusion coefficient | µH2O = 1,8 × 10⁴; Requirement for | SD, H2O ≤ 5 m; breathability (EN ISO 7783)
    - Carbonation resistance: Dry film thickness | d = 130 µm; Equivalent air layer | SD, CO2 = 429 m; thickness; Diffusion coefficient CO2 | µCO2 = 3,3 × 10⁶; Requirement for | SD, CO2 ≥ 50 m; carbonation resistance (EN 1062-6)
5.9 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.10 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor, March 2025, Version 04.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/sikagard_-680_s_betoncolor.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: MSDS Sikagard-680 S Colorless GHS7.pdf, version 28/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/MSDS%20Sikagard-680%20S%20Colorless%20GHS7%20(1).pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikagard - 680 S Bentoncolor GHS7.PDF, version 28/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/f/SDS%20Sikagard%20-%20680%20S%20Bentoncolor%20GHS7%20(3).pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikagardÂ®-680 S Betoncolor colorless, https://aus.sika.com/dms/getdocument.get/ac62dec1-d302-4056-be94-3b1ee30a4f4e_au01/sds-sikagard-680sbetoncolorcolorless.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Ecology, health and safety - Directive 2004/42/ce limitation of emissions of.
    - VOC
    - According to the EU-Directive 2004/42, the maximum allowed content of VOC (Product category IIA / i type sb) is 500 (Limit 2010) for the ready to use product. The maximum content of Sikagard®-680 S Betoncolor is < 500 g/l VOC for the ready to use product.
6.4 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.5 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.6 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
